div.head: Episc 7
div.ab: A he sceal scyldan Cristenum mannum wið ælc þæra þinga þe synlic bið; ⁊ þy he sceal on æghwæt hine þe swyðor teon, þæt he þe geornor wite, hu seo heord fare, þe he to Godes handa gehealdan sceall, þæt deofol to swyðe þæron na sceaþige, ne his falses to fela ongemang ne gesawe.

He must always shield Christian men against each of those things which are sinful; and thus he must devote himself the more deeply in all matters so that he might know the more truly how the flock fares which he must tend on God's behalf, so that the devil may not inflict harm too greatly thereon nor sow too much his falseness among them.

Semper debet Christianis preuidere contra omnia quę peccati sunt; et ideo debet se magis de pluribus intromittere ut, melius sciat, quomodo grex agat, quem ad Dei manum debet custodire (cu. suscepit), ne diabolus eum dilaniet, nec falsum suum (malum aliquod) superseminet.
